ns2:section.sectionText: Online and Continuing Education (OCE) restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.oce.illinois.edu. Class sessions will be held on the following dates: Aug 29, Sept 8, 19, & 29, Oct 10 & 20, Nov 10 & 28. Wed sessions will meet from 5:30-9:30pm. Saturday sessions will meet from 8:00am ? 5:00pm. This class is restricted to EdM and CAS students in cohort 11. This course is part of a self-supporting program and DOES NOT accept the following tuition and fee waivers (TFWs): Cooperating Teacher waivers, Non-Academic waivers (including UIUC employees and employees of other state institutions), Academic waivers from UIUC, UIC and UIS employees, Related Agency waivers, Field Supervisor waivers, waivers granted through fellowships/assistantships as governed by the Graduate College at UIUC, or Retiree waivers. This program DOES accept statutory waivers (veterans grants, etc.).
